catalog_description: Glottolog catalogs American Sign Language (ISO 639-3: ase) as a language under the Sign Language grouping.

catalog_identity_evidence.evidence_scope: catalog identity and fields only; not an audit of the independent definition or example

definition: A natural visual language that uses handshape, movement, location, and nonmanual signals.
entry_text: A natural visual language that uses handshape, movement, location, and nonmanual signals.
example: An interpreter signs a classroom question in ASL.
label: American Sign Language

sources.note: Ferrara et al. describe handshape, movement, location and nonmanual features and use ASL dictionaries in their analysis. NIDCD independently confirms the natural signed-language classification: https://www.nidcd.nih.gov/health/american-sign-language.
